name: Franklin Financial Services Corporation
summary: Franklin Financial Services Corporation operates as the bank holding company for Farmers and Merchants Trust Company of Chambersburg that provides banking services to businesses, individuals, and governmental entities in Pennsylvania. It offers various deposit products, including demand deposits, savings, money management accounts, time deposits, and certificates of deposits.
